entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“How can I help?”"
entries.dialogueText: “How can I help?”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“It could be accomplished, but it w..."
entries.dialogueText: “It could be accomplished, but it would hurt the trust the mayors have placed in me and the Ministry.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“I'm against administrative interve..."
entries.dialogueText: “I'm against administrative intervention in local governments, especially in a city like Anrica. We'll lose trust.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“I appreciate that you hold me in s..."
entries.dialogueText: “I appreciate that you hold me in such high esteem, but I'm reluctant about this move.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We can repair that trust in the ne..."
entries.dialogueText: “We can repair that trust in the near future. But right now we need this man weakened.”
entries.menuText: “We can repair that trust in the near future. But right now we need this man weakened.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""At the expense of yet more pressur..."
entries.dialogueText: "At the expense of yet more pressure on myself and my staff."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Your personal support and weight i..."
entries.dialogueText: “Your personal support and weight is needed. This needs to look as if it came from you.”
entries.menuText: “Your personal support and weight is needed. This needs to look as if it came from you.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lileas hung up the phone."
entries.dialogueText: Lileas hung up the phone.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“She won't upset the mayors at all..."
entries.dialogueText: “She won't upset the mayors at all costs, even one who insulted the First Lady. So much for female solidarity!”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We'll keep in touch.”"
entries.dialogueText: “We'll keep in touch.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Very much appreciated, Lileas.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Very much appreciated, Lileas.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“I support you as much as I am able..."
entries.dialogueText: “I support you as much as I am able to. I must excuse myself now.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“That was a waste of valuable time...."
entries.dialogueText: “That was a waste of valuable time. But at least Lileas revealed her ambitions.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Maybe it will blow over. You might..."
entries.dialogueText: “Maybe it will blow over. You might be right.”
entries.menuText: “Maybe it will blow over. You might be right.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“With time it should. I must excuse..."
entries.dialogueText: “With time it should. I must excuse myself now."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I don't see Iosef accepting this.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I don't see Iosef accepting this.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lileas sighed heavily."
entries.dialogueText: Lileas sighed heavily.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I haven't heard of this before.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I haven't heard of this before.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“I'm still working on the proposal..."
entries.dialogueText: “I'm still working on the proposal and legal backing for it. I was going to mention it later.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“Well, he just might have to agree..."
entries.dialogueText: “Well, he just might have to agree if the President of Sordland tells him to.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“Yet I would gladly support you......"
entries.dialogueText: “Yet I would gladly support you... if you back my plan to put the Gendarmerie under the Ministry of Interior.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I will support you in the Gendarme..."
entries.dialogueText: “I will support you in the Gendarmerie authority transfer. Now it's your turn.”
entries.menuText: “I will support you in the Gendarmerie authority transfer. Now it's your turn.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I can't make that promise. Iosef w..."
entries.dialogueText: “I can't make that promise. Iosef would be furious.”
entries.menuText: “I can't make that promise. Iosef would be furious.”

entries.dialogueText: “That is unfortunate. In that case there is not much I can do, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“Excellent. I'll make arrangements..."
entries.dialogueText: “Excellent. I'll make arrangements to remove the mayor from his post.”

entries.speaker: Player

entries.dialogueText: “I'm disappointed in the lack of support from you. I expected more.”
entries.menuText: “I'm disappointed in the lack of support from you. I expected more.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“Goodbye.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Goodbye.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade

entries.dialogueText: “Let's hope this arrangement won't backfire on us. It's true that Iosef will object."

entries.dialogueText: “In the short term, though, we need to make Leste's removal seem as necessary as possible.”

entries.dialogueText: The Minister of the Interior was on the line.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Livia left the room to arrange the..."
entries.dialogueText: Livia left the room to arrange the call. A few minutes later, the phone lit up.

entries.speaker: Livia Suno
entries.title: Livia Suno: "“I'll let you know once I have her..."
entries.dialogueText: “I'll let you know once I have her on the line.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Yes please.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Yes please.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“That would be appreciated.”"
entries.dialogueText: “That would be appreciated.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Petr left the room and came back wi..."
entries.dialogueText: Petr left the room and came back with Livia. She had on a short dress and dark eyeliner -- clearly she'd been counting on me being away at the festival for longer. Still, her demeanor was nothing but professional.

entries.speaker: Livia Suno
entries.title: Livia Suno: "“As you wish.”"
entries.dialogueText: “As you wish.”

entries.speaker: Livia Suno
entries.title: Livia Suno: "“Mr. Vectern told me what happened...."
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. Vectern told me what happened. Should I connect you with the Interior Minster directly?”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Taking the fight to him is the rig..."
entries.dialogueText: “Taking the fight to him is the right approach. Proactive behavior will benefit us.”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“Lileas is his superior -- she ough..."
entries.dialogueText: “Lileas is his superior -- she ought to side with us and remove him from his post. I'll ask Livia to call her.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A few minutes later, the phone lit..."
entries.dialogueText: A few minutes later, the phone lit up. The Minister of the Interior was on the line.

entries.speaker: Livia Suno
entries.title: Livia Suno: "“I'd be careful, though. I doubt Mr..."
entries.dialogueText: “I'd be careful, though. I doubt Mrs. Graf will remove Mayor Leste without asking for something in return.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“After what you said about my wife?..."
entries.dialogueText: “After what you said about my wife? No.”
entries.menuText: “After what you said about my wife? No.”

entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“This isn't even counting my person..."
entries.dialogueText: “This isn't even counting my personal feelings about the matter. Mr. Rayne, I chose a political career at the expense of becoming a mother. Your wife did not. Leste was right -- her place is at home, not on that stage."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Speak to Lileas, Mr. President. Un..."
entries.dialogueText: "Speak to Lileas, Mr. President. Unless you'd rather take advice from someone in a conical brassiere.”
